title: Progressive flight prediction
summary: Isolated, bounded and removable preview state.

blocks.text: view.prediction@1.0.0 creates one progressive flight preview per consumer. Pass a compatible public SimulationContext, detached ship state, active body/surface and selected ship identity; world-aware rule previews additionally receive WorldRead. The owner supplies SI body-relative state and elapsed wall seconds. Prediction clones own their caches/state; the live world is never advanced by the view.

Ship, body, surface, motion identity and relevant command epochs invalidate a preview. While tracing, only the new path prefix is shown. Invalidation, completion, generator failure and provider removal close both the generator and isolated context, even if one cleanup fails. A disposed instance rejects updates. Independent views retain separate budgets/jobs.

maxMs, traceSamplesPerSecond and numericalSamplesPerSecond change viewer work scheduling, preserving original default budgets and numerical results. Explicit guest maxMs takes precedence. A generic non-flight game need not select this flight-specific service. A game requiring prediction declares view.prediction as required; optional omission removes the preview instead of inventing a provider. Manifest selection replaces compatibility app construction in Phase 4.
